title: FRANK module manifest
description: FRANK-§6.1. A versioned, schema-validated module declaration specifying capabilities, dependencies, data access, UI routes, events, and health checks.

id.description: Module identifier in dot-separated lowercase form, e.g. brain.youtube.

kind.description: Module classification: feature, integration, policy, workflow, or system.

depends_on.description: Array of module dependency specifications with semantic version constraints.

provides.description: Array of capabilities this module exports to the system.

data_scopes.description: FRANK-§2.3. Array of data classification levels this module is approved to process.

ui.description: User interface routes and widgets exposed by this module.

routes.description: Array of route paths provided by this module.

widgets.description: Array of widget identifiers provided by this module.

events.description: Event types consumed and emitted by this module.

consumes.description: Array of event type patterns this module subscribes to.

emits.description: Array of event types this module produces.

permissions.description: Authorization scopes required by this module.

required.description: Array of permission identifiers required for operation.

health_checks.description: Named health check points that verify module dependencies and critical paths.
